da-vacuous.notes: Honest manuscript statement, but the Lean context class makes tr, nrm, tau_hat arbitrary ℝ->ℝ and base_mass an arbitrary ℝ, with body `sorry`. The theorem ||tr(tau_hat alpha)|| = base_mass with all symbols free is essentially a definitional pin on base_mass that no instance is forced to satisfy; as a verification artifact it encodes none of the descent/Frobenius-compatibility content. Honest-sorry per §1a but content-free as a proof.

da-circular.notes: No assumption of the conclusion; the prior intermediate_mass laundered version was removed per the Lean notes.

da-overclaim.notes: The proof asserts the trace-descent compatibility 'tr_n . d_{n+1} = tr_{n+1} on im(tau_hat)' as a given (line 6-8) and the ascent-embedding isomorphism, then derives the result in two lines and writes QED — but the Lean obligation is `sorry` and these compatibility facts are not themselves formalized/proved here. So a narrative QED is claimed for a result whose key inputs are asserted, not established. Milder than the eigenspace block since the inputs are individually plausible standard facts.

da-non-sequitur.notes: Given its asserted inputs (im(tau_hat) ≅ End(A_n) via ascent embedding; trace-descent compatibility), the chain tr(tau_hat alpha) = tr(l_n(d_{n+1}(alpha))) = tr_n(d_{n+1}(alpha)) = tr_n(alpha_0) is a valid substitution sequence, and ||.|| = m(rho_0) follows by definition. No internal logical gap, modulo the unproven inputs (covered under overclaim/vacuous).

da-referee-verdict.notes: verdict=major-revision. referee_argument: The lemma statement ||tr(tau_hat alpha)|| = m(rho_0) is sound and its two-line proof is logically valid GIVEN its asserted inputs (im(tau_hat) ≅ End(A_n) via the ascent embedding, and trace-descent compatibility tr_n . d_{n+1} = tr_{n+1} on im(tau_hat)). The objection is maturity, not error: those inputs are asserted not proved, the Lean theorem is a `sorry` over a context class of unconstrained opaque operators (encoding none of the descent structure), and the narrative still writes QED. Unlike the sibling eigenspace lemma there is no false step — so this is a completeness/formalization gap (stated-not-proved) rather than a wrong claim. Formalize the descent/trace-compatibility infrastructure or downgrade the QED to a proof sketch.
